name: BARTEC Agile S NI
summary: The BARTEC Agile S NI is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) 10.1-inch Windows tablet from BARTEC, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX, IECEx and UKEX. It runs Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC.
imageAlt: BARTEC Agile S NI, front view

otherSchemes: Inmetro, KC (Korea), CCC (China), CML Japan (JPN 2082X), UL Brazil

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIB T130°C Dc IP64
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2020-01-17), checked 2026-10-26. UKEX CML 21UKEX2346X issue 0 (2021-06-24) read; it refers to EPS 19 ATEX 1 179X issue 0, confirming the ATEX number. ATEX certificate PDF is a scan and was not read.

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / Ex ic IIIB T130°C Dc IP64

certification.northAmerica: NEC 500: Class I Div 2 Groups A, B, C, D T4A (CSA file 180267); operating −10 °C to +50 °C

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: battery pack changed or charged only outside hazardous areas; connection or disconnection of external ports, opening the enclosure or replacing the battery live only if the atmosphere is shown to be absent; protect from high-energy impacts, permanent UV and static-generating processes; ambient −20 °C to +50 °C; follow the manufacturer's safety instructions strictly. Quick start guide: battery must be locked in the Ex area; connectors not to be used in the Ex area.
safety.peripherals: All external I/O (micro HDMI, USB-A, USB-C, audio, DC charging, microSD, micro-SIM) sit under a protective cover and may be used outside hazardous areas only. Headset connection only outside Ex areas. Non-certified accessories endanger explosion protection.
safety.certifiedAccessories: BARTEC accessory sheet 435825 lists carry case, 4-point belt, leather carry case, docking and vehicle accessories; which items are Ex-rated for use inside Ex areas was not checked.

os.name: Windows
os.edition: Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2021, version 21H2 (BARTEC image SNILTSC21R02, build 114), 64-bit, multilingual

specs.chip: Intel Core i5-7300U (Kaby Lake) 2.6 GHz, turbo 3.5 GHz
specs.ports: Micro HDMI; USB 3.0 Type A; USB 3.0 Type C; audio combo; DC charging port; microSD; micro-SIM; built-in Honeywell N6600 1D/2D imager; HF RFID reader 13.56 MHz
specs.docking: Accessory sheet lists docking and vehicle accessories (not read)
specs.gnss: GPS/QZSS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo ready, up to 2.5 m precision
specs.keys: Power, home, 2 programmable function keys, 2 volume keys
specs.touch: Projective capacitive; finger, stylus or glove mode
specs.storage: 256 GB mSATA SSD, MicroSD (SDXC up to 2 TB)

capabilities.label: RFID
capabilities.value: Built in (HF 13.56 MHz reader, read/write ISO 14443 A/B, 15693, Mifare, FeliCa)

capabilities.label: High-accuracy GNSS
capabilities.value: Built in (GNSS module, up to 2.5 m precision; not RTK)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (8 MP rear, 2 MP front cameras)

capabilities.label: Windows desktop software
capabilities.value: Built in (Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC, x86)

unconfirmed.launchYear: Approximate: the maker doesn't publish a launch date. Based on the certificate date or the maker's announcement.

strengths: ATEX, IECEx and UKEX certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 2 in North America
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
